milestones: Procrastinator: Leave Out Food to Spoil; Let 3 Kitchen or Bathroom Objects Get Dirty; Let At Least One Floor Level of your Home Become Dirty; Max Out (Sim Name)'s Fun Motive While on a Dusty, Dirty, or Filthy Floor | Chore Dodger: Successfully Ask 3 Sims to Clean; Befriend a Dust Bunny; Cook 3 Meals on a Dirty or Filthy Floor Level; Pay for a Cleaning Service | Low Standards: Eat 3 Meals that are Spoiled; Bathe or Shower 3 Times in a Dirty Shower or Tub; Don't Wash Your Hands After Using the Toilet; Invite a Guest Over while House is Dirty or Filthy | Filth Fiend: Knock Over 3 Trash Cans; Throw a Party Social Event in a Filthy House; Appease a Filth Field with a Filth Tribute; WooHoo in a Filthy House

description: This Sim wants to immerse themselves in everything Tomarang has to offer!
reward_trait_description: Sims with this Trait are better at cooking Tomarani Cuisine, finding Tassels, getting along with Sims with the Child of the Village trait, and will be more successful when exploring the Sulea Tiger Sanctuary and the Cave at Beard Beard Cove.
milestones: Regional Rookie: Leave Fruit or Incense at a Spirit House; Use Tomarani Introduction; Meet a Sim with the Child of the Village Personality Trait; Use a Squat Toilet | Culinary Conoisseur: Cook Tomarani Cuisine; Buy a Shirt from the Night Market; Buy Food at the Night Market; Prepare a Recipe using a Pressure Cooker | Explorer Extraordinaire: Collect Unique Tassels; Explore Tomarang's Cave; Explore the Sulea Tiger Sanctuary; View the Statue of Khun Mae and the Tiger

description: This Sim wants to play the field and go on all sorts of dates with people!
reward_trait_description: Players will never cause other Sims to get jealous, no matter what they do.
milestones: Amore Amateur: Have a boyfriend or girlfriend; Go on 2 dates | Up to Date: Achieve level 4 charisma skill; Have had 3 first kisses | Romance Juggler: Achieve level 6 charisma skill; Have a strong romantic relationship with 3 Sims at once; Kiss 10 Sims | Serial Romantic: Earn gold on 3 dates; Have had 8 boyfriends or girlfriends

description: This Sim wants to find and live a rewarding life with "The One"!
reward_trait_description: Sims with a Companion have special interactions with their spouse that help ease the trials of life.
milestones: Amore Amateur: Have a boyfriend or girlfriend; Go on 2 dates | Marriage Material: Become an adult; Be married to BFF | Love Handler: Earn silver on 2 dates with spouse; Achieve soulmate relationship with spouse | Soulmate: Perform 50 romantic gestures with spouse as soulmates; Earn gold on 3 dates with spouse

description: This Sim wants to explore all that romance has to offer.
reward_trait_description: Seasoned Romantic Sims find their romantic relationships with other Sims grow faster. They also get over embarrassment faster since they know that you don't need to be embarrassed when it comes to love.
milestones: Spark of Love: Go on a Get To Know You Date; Achieve Level 2 Romance Skill; Use the Romantic Blanket 3 Times for Romance; Share Food 2 Times | Expanding Boundaries: Discuss Romantic Boundaries; Have a Romantic Partner; Achieve Level 4 Romance Skill; Embrace 3 Times | Amour Connoisseur: Get Gold on a Romantic Date; Achieve Level 7 Romance Skill; Perform 25 Romantic Gestures with a Partner Sim; WooHoo 3 Times at Different Locations

description: This Sim wants to have successful relationships with two or more Sims.
reward_trait_description: Affection Aficionado Sims have slower Romantic Satisfaction loss in relationships with other Sims. The rate of change is slowed to less than 1% the normal speed.
milestones: Paragon Partner: Discuss Romantic Boundaries; Have 2 or More Partners; Have 2 or More Very Satisfied Relationships; Go on 3 Dates with a Partner Sim

description: This Sim wants to grow plants and become an expert Gardener!
reward_trait_description: Sims that are Naturalists don't need to fear fire; it won't touch them, and they can extinguish it with ease.
milestones: Naturewalker: Plant something 3 times; Weed or water plants 10 times | Garden Variety: Achieve level 4 gardening skill; Evolve 5 different plants | Nature Nurturer: Achieve level 6 gardening skill; Graft onto 3 plants; Fertilize 5 plants | Freelance Botanist: Achieve level 10 gardening skill; Grow a cowplant; Evolve 10 excellent plants

description: This Sim wants to collect everything this world has to offer!
reward_trait_description: Appraisers can sell collectibles, like Metals, Crystals, Elements, and Fossils to the Simsonian Museum for extra money.
milestones: Out and About: Collect 10 collectibles | Gatherer: Collect 5 crystals; Collect 3 frogs; Collect 3 fossils | Treasure Hunter: Send 5 items to the geological council; Breed 5 frogs; Collect 5 elements | The Curator: Complete a collection; Collect 25 collectibles

description: This Sim wants to know everything about fishing!
reward_trait_description: Sims with Angler's Tranquility will find that all of their problems seem to melt away while they are fishing.
milestones: Fish out of Water: Catch 5 fish; Fish at 3 different locations | Hooked: Fish for 10 total hours; Mount or bowl 5 fish; Achieve level 4 fishing skill | Reel Smart: Catch 5 fish using bait; Make 6 great catches; Achieve level 6 fishing skill | Angling Ace: Collect 20 types of fish; Achieve level 10 fishing skill

description: Outdoor Enthusiasts want to experience everything nature has to offer!
reward_trait_description: Survivalists are happy roughin' it and like living off the land. Sleeping under the stars or using camping equipment provides lots of enjoyment.
milestones: Greenhorn: Harvest 10 unidentified plants; Catch 5 fish in Granite Falls | Forest Scout: Achieve level 4 herbalism skill; Cook 2 plates of beetles over a campfire; Eat 10 plants | Wilderness Explorer: Craft 3 excellent herbal remedies; Identify all unidentified plants; Befriend the hermit of Granite Falls | Outdoor Enthusiast: Achieve level 10 herbalism skill; Sleep for 5 nights in a tent; Collect 15 insects

description: This Sim wants to explore the jungle! Sims who select this Aspiration will complete a series of actions related to the exploration.
reward_trait_description: Treasure Hunters have a sharp eye and will occasionally find treasure and relics in Treasure Chests that other Sims miss.
milestones: Vacationer: Buy 3 Goods at the Marketplace; Eat a Selvadoradian Meal; View Statue of Madre Cosecha | Expedition Rookie: Achieve Level 3 Selvadoradian Culture Skill; Find an Area off the Path; Examine 3 Traps | Regional Master: Defend Against 2 Natural Dangers; Achieve Level 5 Selvadoradian Culture Skill; Assemble a Mystical Relic | Jungle Explorer: Open 3 Rare Omiscan Treasure Chests; Activate a Mystical Relic 5 Times; Find 5 Omiscan Treasures

description: This Sim wants to learn every potion's recipe and craft each one!
reward_trait_description: As a Master Mixer, <Sim name> rarely fails when using potions on themselves.
milestones: First Steps: Become a Spellcaster; Travel to The Magic Realm; Learn a Potion Recipe | Bubbling Up: Reach Spellcaster Rank 2 - Acolyte; Own a Cauldron; Know 3 Different Potions | Cauldron Connections: Reach Spellcaster Rank 3 - Adept; Know 5 Different Potions; Brew 5 Potions | Potion Pro: Reach Spellcaster Rank 5 - Virtuoso; Know 10 Different Potions

description: This Sim wants to build a better, greener community.
reward_trait_description: When Influential Individuals speak, everyone listens. They can get the community to cheer on a local hero, or cancel them on a whim.
milestones: Eco-Economist: Have 5 community influence points; Vote on 1 neighborhood action plan | Clean City Civilian: Sell power or water on a utility bill; Become a civil designer | Civil Citizen: Attempt to convince a Sim to vote on a neighborhood action plan; Vote on neighborhood action plans two separate times; Reach level 10 of the civil designer career

description: Country Caretakers want to tend the countryside and befriend all animals and critters!
reward_trait_description: Nature Conversationalist Sims have improved relationships with animals, allowing their animals to live longer, happier lives. Rabbits and birds will bring them more gifts. And they can interact with plants in unique ways, receiving more yield from harvests. They will also receive free grocery delivery, and, when residing in Henford-on Bagley, a discount on their bills.
milestones: Campestral Curator: Purchase 1 Cow, Chicken, or Llama on Your Home Lot; Socialize with a Fox, Rabbit, or Bird 5 Times; Purchase 1 Garden Patch for Your Home Lot; Visit Finchwick, Old New Henford, and the Bramblewood Neighborhoods in Henford-on-Bagley | Agrestic Savant: Befriend a Chicken, Cow, or Llama; Place 1 Wild Rabbit Home or Flock of Wild Birds on your Home Lot; Fertilize 3 Plants or Oversized Crops | Critter Keeper: Give 3 Gifts to Foxes, Rabbits, or Birds; Craft Animal Treats 5 Times; Harvest 1 Perfect Quality Oversized Crop; Forage 5 Items from the Bramblewood | Legendairy: Reach Maximum Relationship with a Cow, Chicken, or Llama; Receive 3 Gifts from Rabbits or Birds; Win a Competition in Henford-on-Bagley's Finchwick Fair

description: This Sim wants to cut gemstones, craft jewelry, and harness the power of the crystals!
reward_trait_description: Attuned Sims have great insights into the mysteries of crystals. The jewelry they wear will remain charged for longer, and they can absorb energy from charged crystals.
milestones: Curious Collector: Buy a Gemology Table; Collect 5 Crystals or Metals; Gift Jewelry or Successfully Propose with Crafted Ring | Bauble Broker: Buy a Crystal Grid; Wear a Fully Charged Jewelry Piece; Plant a Crystal Seed | Gifted Gemologist: Grow a Magnificent Crystal Tree; Make 5 pieces of Excellent Jewelry; Complete Crafting Gemstones or Jewelry 10 Times While Focused | Legendary Lapidary: Cut a Gemstone Valued at §2,500; Achieve Level 10 Gemology Skill; Summon the Grim Reaper with Jet Gemstone or Jewelry

description: This Sim embraces Natural Living and enjoys fulfilling their every need in the great outdoors.
reward_trait_description: Sims with this trait find their Balance out in the natural world and have a little extra fun when they run into the Garden Pal of Innisgreen.
milestones: Self-Sufficient Sim: Catch a Fish; Harvest a Plant on Elric's Home Lot; Forage for Food 5 Times | Natural Living Expert: Sleep Soundly Outdoors on the Ground 3 Times; Talk to Nature 3 Times with level 9 or Higher Natural Living Skill; Comfortably Bathe in Open Water 3 Times

description: This Sim wants to explore the rich worlds of butterflies and fish to learn all they can about critters!
reward_trait_description: These Sims can chat with butterflies, as well as fish in fish bowls or aquariums. They can also Enthuse about Critters to other Sims! They also have learned the mystical mating ritual of butterflies, allowing them to be able to perform unique butterfly-themed Romantic interactions on other Sims.
milestones: Amateur Lepidopterist: Purchase a Butterfly & Moth Habitat; Catch 5 Butterflies; Examine 3 Common Butterflies; Craft 3 Paper Butterflies | Critter Allure: Craft 3 Paper Mache Animals; Catch 4 Fish while Bowfishing; Go Fishing with a Buddy; Give a Pet Fish a Name | Aspirant Lepidopterist: Catch and Examine a Rare Butterfly; Rehome Butterfly at a Gibbi Point Topiary; View Butterfly in a Butterfly & Moth Habitat; Start Raising a Caterpillar | Refined Catch: Craft a Magical Origami Butterfly; Complete the Butterflies & Moths Collection; Research Mating Rituals of butterflies; Achieve Level 5 Entomology

description: This Sim wants to tell jokes and become an famous comedian!
reward_trait_description: Hilarious Sims can never go wrong with a joke, and have a few extra-special ones up their sleeve.
milestones: Practical Joker: Be funny to 5 Sims; Achieve level 3 comedy skill | Stand-up Start-up: Become an adult; Join the entertainer career; Own a microphone | Funny Businessman/Businesswoman: Achieve level 6 comedy skill; Join the comedian branch of the entertainer career; Write 3 comedy routines | Joke Star: Perform 3 comedy routines; Achieve level 10 comedy skill

description: This Sim wants to throw and attend amazing parties!
reward_trait_description: Perfect Hosts get a boost to the score of any social event they throw.
milestones: New in Town: Introduce self to 10 Sims; Have 3 friends | Welcoming Host: Throw 3 parties; Earn silver on 3 social events | Sir Gala Had: Earn silver on 3 thrown parties; Attend social events at 5 unique locations | Party Animal: Throw 10 social events; Attend 15 social events; Earn gold on 2 thrown parties

description: This Sim wants to make and keep as many friends as they can!
reward_trait_description: Everyone remembers a Beloved Sim! Their relationships never fade.
milestones: New in Town: Introduce self to 10 Sims; Have 3 friends | Well Liked: Meet someone new in 3 different locations; Achieve level 4 charisma skill | Super Friend: Have 12 friends; Achieve level 6 charisma skill | Friend of the world: Have 20 friends; Make a BFF; Achieve level 10 charisma skill

description: This Sim wants to provide all manner of advice, to be a positive influence in the lives of their neighbors.
reward_trait_description: Confidantes are able to easily avoid boring conversations and are more successful in getting to know others.
milestones: Neighborly Advisor: Successfully advise and influence the lives of other Sims!; Become Good Friends with 5 Sims; Achieve level 7 Charisma Skill

description: This Sim wants to be the leader of the best Club in Town!
reward_trait_description: Sims that are Natural Leaders will earn Club points much faster, and they will be able to overthrow other leaders with ease.
milestones: Get Accepted: Start or Join a Club; Buy a Club Perk | Private Gathering: Be in a Club Gathering for 12 Hours; Perform 10 Club Activities | Spread the Word: Achieve Level 5 charisma Skill; Talk about Clubs with 5 Club members | Leader of the Pack: Earn 1000 Club Points; Lead a Club with 8 Sims

description: This Sim wants to tame his/her thirst and remain as human as possible!
reward_trait_description: Vampires with Regained Humanity seem kinder and safer. Sims are more likely give permission to Drink.
milestones: The Transformation: Use a Computer to Search for Information on Vampires; Become a Vampire; Reach Vampire Lore level 3 | Cope with Temptation: Drink a Plasma Pack; Make 5 Friends; Don't drink deeply for 5 days in a row; Reach Vampire Lore level 4 | Circle of Trust: Make 2 Good Friends; Get Permission to Drink from 2 Different Sims; Purchase the "Tamed Thirst" Power; Create 3 Plasma Packs from Fish or Frogs | Reject The Beast: Make a BFF; Don't drink without permission for 14 days in a row; Harvest from a Plasma Fruit Tree 3 Times

description: This Sim wants to become illustriously famous.
reward_trait_description: Sims with Unstoppable Fame are immortalized celebrities, incapable of experiencing fame decay over time. They're so comfortable in the limelight they'll never react poorly towards those pesky paparazzi. They also receive an extra Fame Perk point.
milestones: Aspiring Star: Become a 2 star celebrity; Purchase a Fame Perk | Somebody: Become a 3 star celebrity; Visit a Celebrity hot spot; Host a Meet and Greet | Rising Star: Become a 4 star celebrity; Be asked 3 times for a selfie; Deal with the paparazzi 3 times | World-Famous Celebrity: Become a 5 star celebrity; Receive 25 positive responses from inciting cheers; Sign 3 autographs

description: This Sim aspires to be the perfect Tenant and neighbor in a Residential Rental!
reward_trait_description: These Sims are better at negotiating Rent forgiveness, getting along with neighbors, won't have their belongings repossessed by their Property Owner, and host better Events.
milestones: First Time Renter: Live in a Residential Rental; Meet a Residential Rental Neighbor; Have the Property Owner Visit Your Unit | Seasoned Tenant: Fix Something during an Emergency or Maintenance Event; Host a Neighborhood Potluck or Pool Party Event; Use an Amenity in a Shared Space | Friendly Founder: Achieve Gold in a Neighborhood Potluck or Pool Party Event; Become Good Friends with Your Property Owner; Successfully Break a Unit Rule

description: This Sim wants to run a small business full of happy customers, either through business practices rooted in idealistic dreams or tricky hustles based on pragmatic schemes.
reward_trait_description: These Sims form a brand that is beloved by everyone, leading to more successful Small Businesses. Any Small Business they run will automatically have more positive reviews, and customers will leave with a positive relationship bonus if they had a good time at the business.
milestones: Popular Operator: Grow Your Small Business to a Striving Startup; Reach the first level of Dreamer or Schemer Alignment; Hire an Employee and Become Friends with Them | Honored Home Businessperson: Get a Happy Customer; Grow Your Small Business to a Neighborhood Gem; Reach the second level of Dreamer or Schemer Alignment | Esteemed Entrepreneur: Grow Your Small Business to a Local Legend; Get 5 more Happy Customers; Reach the third level of Dreamer or Schemer Alignment

description: On the world of Batuu there is a growing conflict. This Sim is out to explore Black Spire Outpost and understand whether they should stand with the Resistance of the First Order. and is a requirement to follow the Paragon of Hope and Enforcer of Order aspirations.
reward_trait_description: A payment of credits by your chosen faction for your support in their cause.
milestones: First Steps: Visit Every Neighbourhood on Batuu; Ask About Resistance or First Order presence on Batuu; Complete a Mission for the Resistance or First Order Faction

reward_trait_description: Heroic Sims gain Charisma more easily, and can also inspire other Sims with their presence.

description: This Sim isn't about choosing sides, they're happy just mingling among the smugglers, and bounty hunters on the fringe planet of Batuu. Earning a few extra credits along the way is just a bonus, no matter how they get them.

description: This Sim is on quest to achieve Inner Peace. Although true harmony is sometimes ephemeral, what's important is developing tools to help mitigate negative emotions.
reward_trait_description: This Sim has clear head on their shoulders! Sims with Clear Perspective will be able to have a brief respite from the harshness of reality and re-contextualize things. Like how it's all sort of meaningless... but in a good way!
milestones: Practice Mindfulness; Seek Relaxation; Find Peaceful Surroundings; Maintain Harmony

description: This Sim wants to make it big with monetizing Wellness activities like offering Manicures or Tending the Massage Table at Spa.
reward_trait_description: This Sim will be the Self-Care Expert and develop an expertise for all things Wellness. Clients will now cough up way more money for her services.
milestones: Hustle; Gain Self-Care Notoriety; Become a Spa Regular; Maintain a Regular Customer

description: This sim wants to share their mastery of Wellness with the world, and train a successor to pass on their knowledge.
reward_trait_description: When Sim masters wellness it will allow him to emanate a soothing glow! Use this newfound ability to calm Sims around him, and... well, to look awesome!
milestones: Comfort Others; Guide Others; Share Detox Tea; Become a Master Wellness Teacher

reward_trait_description: Fanged Friends get an additional boost to their relationships with both Werewolves and non-Werewolf Sims
milestones: Lunar Attunement: Become a Werewolf; Level up to Runt; Experience a Full Moon; Read Werewolf Books 3 Times

description: This Sim wants to become the strongest and most feared werewolf, all on his/her own!
reward_trait_description: Sims with a Threatening Presence inspire more fear in those around them, sometimes to the point of fainting. And Greg? Well, to them, he might as well be a cute puppy.
milestones: Solo Hunt: Level up to Apex; Unleash the Beast 25 Times; Spar with Werewolves 5 Times; Defeat Greg in a Werewolf Brawl

description: This sim wants to join The Moonwood Collective and become a friendly ambassador to all!
reward_trait_description: Refined Lupines turn their noses up at the thought of losing control of their Fury, passively generating less of it over time.
milestones: Community Canine: Join the Moonwood Collective; Socialize with Werewolf Friends 4 Times; Be a Good Werewolf Ambassador 15 Times; Become Alpha of the Moonwood Collective

description: This Sim wants to join the Wildfangs and unapologetically take on the world as a Werewolf!
reward_trait_description: Sims turned into werewolves by Chomp Champions won't negatively react to being turned, and they'll want to join the Chomp Champion's pack, too!
milestones: Going Wild Worldwide: Join the Wildfangs; Turn 3 Sims into Werewolves; Werewolf World Domination! 25 times; Become Alpha of the Wildfangs

description: This Sim seeks a cure for lycanthropy to live his/her life as a non-werewolf Sim.
reward_trait_description: Sims with a Lunar Link retain the special benefits of the Lunar Cycle they once had as werewolves, and can still howl just like old times!
milestones: Finding a Cure: Harvest 3 Moonpetal; Collect 10 Wolfsbane; Craft Wolf-B-Gone; Drink the Cure

description: This Sim has dreams of succeeding in the arts!

reward_trait_description: Mentally Gifted Sims build adult mental skills faster.

reward_trait_description: These Sims are some of the best event hosts. Their friendly and funny socials during parties will always succeed.
